en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a medieval gate tower with a steep shingled roof and wooden gallery, forming an arched passage through the old town fortifications. A small roundabout, 1960s streetlights, trees and wrought‑iron fencing frame the view; historic houses stand beside the tower. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a blue address, a Romanian stamp (POSTA ROMANA, 40 B, depicting Pioneers), and overlapping postmarks of Mediaș and București dated 15.10.1968. Printed credits include Editura Meridiane and the photographer Al. Florescu.
